Greer has four goals, six points, 23 shots on net and 36 hits in 13 appearances this season.

injuries.name: David Pastrnak
injuries.note: Pastrnak logged 5:50 of ice time Friday before exiting the game. He entered the clash against the Maple Leafs with 11 goals and 32 points through 24 appearances this season. Michael Eyssimont would probably draw into the lineup if Pastrnak isn't an option Sunday versus Vancouver, but obviously, the loss of offense would be extremely difficult for Boston to compensate for. Morgan Geekie and Fraser Minten might be among those who are leaned on more if Boston needs to go a stretch without Pastrnak.

injuries.name: Sam Montembeault
injuries.note: Montembeault hasn't yet appeared in a regular-season game during the 2026-27 campaign, as he sustained a lower-body injury during practice in early October and has been on injured reserve since then. The Canadiens indicated in late October that the netminder had been upgraded to day-to-day, but it's not yet clear when he'll be able to make his season debut. After making a career-high 62 regular-season appearances for Montreal during the 2024-25 campaign, the 30-year-old went 10-8-4 with a 3.43 GAA and .872 save percentage across 25 regular-season outings with the Canadiens last year. The Red Wings already have John Gibson and Daniil Tarasov in the crease, but Gibson hasn't been particularly sharp early in the year, so Montembeault will likely have an opportunity to compete for playing time once he's healthy.

injuries.note: By moving Savoie to LTIR, the Oilers will get some cap relief while he is sidelined, as their injuries have started to pile up. Considering Savoie is expected to miss at least the first two weeks of the season, fantasy managers probably shouldn't be expecting him to significantly outperform those numbers in 2026-27.

He posted a 16-14-5 record with a 3.05 GAA and an .874 save percentage in 35 appearances for Carolina during the 2025-26 regular season. Once he's ready to play in the 2026-27 campaign with the Oilers, Andersen could compete for starts with Tristan Jarry and Devon Levi.
